title: loam tick status --json
description: Whether launchd runs loam tick, and what the last tick did. loam tick install and uninstall print the same.

installed.description: True when the launchd agent is installed.

plist.description: The path of the launchd agent.

interval.description: How often launchd runs loam tick, in seconds.

last_tick.description: The last loam tick. It is left out before the first.

error.description: Why the tick failed, or empty.
